Commitments of Traders — Dashboard

Commitments of Traders data originates with the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (published weekly, Fridays 15:30 US Eastern; a work of the US Government and in the public domain), collected here via myfxbook.com. Non-Commercial = large speculators, Commercial = hedgers, Non-Reportable = small traders. Net position = long − short. Percentile ranks and Stochastic %K are computed as described on each chart.

Provided for information only. This is not investment advice, and no warranty is given as to the accuracy or completeness of the figures shown.
